Class KeepAliveRMI

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.mesos.RMI.KeepAliveRMI
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable
public class KeepAliveRMI extends Object implements Runnable
Manages the keep-alive mechanism for RMI connections by periodically sending heartbeat signals to the remote server.

This class implements Runnable and is intended to be executed in a dedicated background thread. It sends a heartbeat to the server at fixed intervals to signal that the client is still alive and connected. If the server becomes unreachable, the loop is terminated automatically.

  • Method Details

    • run

      public void run()
      Starts the keep-alive loop, sending a heartbeat to the server every 5000L milliseconds.

      The loop continues until one of the following occurs:

      • stop() is called, setting running to false
      • A RemoteException is thrown, indicating the server is unreachable
      • The thread is interrupted externally

      If a RemoteException is caught, an error message is printed to stderr and the loop exits gracefully. If an InterruptedException is caught, the thread's interrupt status is restored before exiting.

      Specified by:
      run in interface Runnable
